name: OpenImageDenoise
listed_description: High-performance, high-quality denoising library for ray-traced images.
reason: Directional claim only. README (v2.5.1) says 'high-performance' and gives no numbers against any named baseline; CHANGELOG.md numbers (about 2x, 1.5-2x for the fast mode, 7-38% faster) compare OIDN with its own earlier versions. The project site openimagedenoise.org is blocked here. Third-party search snippets (not opened) show OptiX denoiser faster than OIDN-CUDA, so no win over a baseline found.

name: OpenSceneGraph
listed_description: An open source high performance 3D graphics toolkit
reason: Directional claims only. README has no benchmark; NEWS.txt release notes say it 'eclipses commercial scene graph toolkits in functionality, stability and performance' with no numbers. A 2009 journal comparison of OpenGL, JOGL, OpenSceneGraph, JavaOSG and Java3D exists (itvs458) but the page is blocked here and no numbers were reachable. The openscenegraph.org site is blocked.

name: PDF-Writer
listed_description: High performance library for creating, modiyfing and parsing PDF files in C++
reason: Directional claim only ('A fast and free C++ library'). README, CHANGELOG and repo pages contain no timings against libharu, PoDoFo, qpdf, poppler or PDFium; a comparison post found by search (pistack.xyz) is blocked here and appears qualitative.

name: pdfio
listed_description: PDFio is a simple C library for reading and writing PDF files.
reason: No performance claim at all. README, CHANGES.md and doc/pdfio.md contain no benchmark or speed figures, and a search for third-party PDF library benchmarks found none that include pdfio.

name: PocketSphinx
reason: Directional claim only ('compactness and efficiency'). README, repo root and test directory have no real-time-factor or speed numbers against another recognizer. The nyumaya wake-word-benchmark runtime README holds only method text with CPU results as images, and the one search hit comparing it with Vosk says Vosk is faster; the 2006 ICASSP PocketSphinx paper is behind a blocked host.

name: Soundpipe
reason: No numeric comparison. README ('lightweight', 'small codebase') and CHANGELOG have no benchmark against Csound, FAUST or any other library; the repo is archived (2024-01-14); a search for CPU comparisons found none.
